text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem is and understand why it happens. Many developers use debugging tools, such as breakpoints and error messages, to help them. A systematic approach is also useful. Instead of guessing, you should test your code step by step. Another helpful method is logging. By adding log statements, you can see what your program is doing and where it fails. With practice, debugging becomes easier and faster.
